value.value: Term Benchmark Loans: Adjusted Term SOFR plus Applicable Margin; RFR Loans: Adjusted Daily Simple SOFR plus Applicable Margin; ABR Loans: ABR plus Applicable Margin. Adjusted Term SOFR = Term SOFR Rate + 0.10%. Applicable Margin for Term Benchmark/RFR Loans ranges 1.125%–1.75%; for ABR Loans 0.125%–0.75% (per Consolidated Leverage Ratio or Index Debt ratings grid). Default rate: applicable rate plus 2%.

(b) Each ABR Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the ABR plus the Applicable Margin.”

synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — intact/rising absolute EBITDA, positive FCF and buybacks offset a genuine negative revenue turn with heavily negative forward revenue-revision breadth.

bull_points.claim: The de-rating is a discrete gap-down from the Feb-3-2026 earnings/Reg-FD event driven by a one-time $150.0M Digital goodwill impairment, not a cash-flow deterioration.

Absolute EBITDA has RISEN across the de-rating window ($1,309M FY24 → $1,311M FY25 → $1,337M LTM Mar-31-2026) even as EBITDA margin % drifted from 21% to 20%, so the margin optics understate underlying earnings power.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: LTM levered free cash flow is a positive $1,064.2M and the primary-source read confirms self-funding (latest-Q OCF>0 AND LTM FCF>0), so this is not a cash-burn story.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: The company is aggressively buying back stock, retiring 13.1% of shares in ~1.8 years (77.06M → 66.95M), consistent with self-funded capital return rather than distress.

The EV/EBITDA discount to the peer median (7.5x vs 10.8x, -31%) sits against a HETEROGENEOUS peer set ($751M–$119.1B, 159x span) anchored by mega-caps like S&P Global and Moody's; the human must judge whether the gap is EARNED (fundamental_deltas show name rev growth 2% vs peer 8%, margin 21% vs 31%) or RESIDUAL overshoot — not read as a clean 'cheap' signal.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name vs peer Median)

bull_points.claim: Leverage is modest — net-debt/EBITDA 1.3x and interest coverage 10.1x — far inside the 4.00x revolver covenant ceiling, so balance-sheet risk is low.

bear_points.claim: Latest same-quarter revenue growth turned NEGATIVE (-1.5% Q1 Mar-31-2026 vs Q1 Mar-31-2025) after a multi-year deceleration (+8% FY23 → +6% FY24 → +4% FY25), and the FY26E revenue line is set to shrink ~1% — this is a genuine top-line signal, not a margin-optics artifact, since the absolute EBITDA reconciler cannot offset falling revenue itself.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: Revenue-estimate breadth is sharply negative (FY2026 0↑/3↓ last month; FQ2/FQ3 2026 Revenue 0↑/11↓ at 2m/3m), and the FY26 consensus revenue path has been cut ~8% over 12 months — a REAL demand signal, not a trailing-multiple misread.
Revenue is highly concentrated in the Insights segment (78% of $6,497M FY25), so the -1.5% top-line turn and negative revenue-revision breadth bear disproportionately on the core franchise.

A genuine counter-point OUTWEIGHED by the positive absolute-EBITDA and FCF facts: the impairment was booked against Digital, and a $20 broker target cut (140 → 120) accompanied the June revisions, signalling some analysts see the weakness as more than one-off.

business_description.value: Gartner, Inc. provides business and technology insights for decisions and performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Insights, Conferences, and Consulting. The Research segment delivers insights through subscription services, such as access to published content, data and benchmarks, and direct access to a network of business and technology experts. The Conferences segment offers executives and teams in an organization the opportunity to learn, share, and network through its Symposium/Xpo series and peer-driven sessions, as well as conferences focused on specific business roles and topics. The Consulting segment provides technology-driven strategic initiatives, including custom analysis and on-the-ground support to senior executives. This segment also offers actionable solutions for IT-related priorities, including IT cost optimization, digital transformation, and IT sourcing optimization. Gartner, Inc. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
